facts.fact: Kunal followed the nanny goat for two days: on the first night a herd boy gave him a cheese rind without asking his name, and he walked into Garh Neshar at dusk on the second day. Ila's summary is 'home in two days'. Aligns ch 20 with the beat and F636's 'third day' (S7 to amend F636).
Kunal says the hill council has followed him for eight winters and none of them holds the whole of the ways (already F637).

As Kunal makes the 'ask nothing back' promise his eyes go to the hem of Ila's pattu where he watched her sew the queen's letter; he recognises the promise covers it and lets it stand. His dawn near-question is therefore a chosen cost biting, not a lapse.
